records.title: OKM communication route through literal AOK1? and FXT
records.readable_german: An OHL. OKM. OKM ueber AOK1? durch FXT erreichbar.
records.meaning: The proposed reading addresses OHL and OKM and reports that OKM can be reached via the literal address AOK1? through FXT. The last address character and FXT are not expanded into a unit identity or named station.
notes: All 86 occupied source slots are retained in native order. The O-like glyph in FAXOX is masked and remains unfilled.

SUBCH to DURCH and EHREACHHAR to ERREICHBAR cost six observed-coordinate substitutions in total. The exact raw layer remains available; the familiar wording is not represented as an unedited source reading.
The unresolved source position in AOK1? has domain {1, 4, A, R, T, U}. It is not necessarily a numerical digit, and the edition does not choose a standard army designation.
FXT remains a literal routing label. The missing interception-time field and separate printed 24.00 line are retained without chronological normalization.

limits: All native source slots remain in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Roundtrip completion witnesses are explicitly nonhistorical.
Observed-coordinate substitutions and source-mask fills are priced separately. A source-compatible word proposal is not proof of unique historical wording.
